officialSources.observation: Official Kerala Integrated Land Information and Management System citizen portal; describes live land parcel maps (LPM) through its services and login/SSO.

Official digital-survey map viewer. Malappuram → Ponnani has 11 entries in the all-villages selector, including Ponnani Nagaram (GID e09a8049-9858-4cb7-b269-454cff5b7da1), but zero entries when restricted to published villages. A page-backed map-view POST returned a viewer shell (location_code 100308, LAND_PARCEL layer); a bounded anonymous GeoJSON export returned an empty HTTP 200 body, not usable geometry. WUP locator and town query point are not equated.
Official survey portal lists Malappuram → Ponnani Taluk survey camp offices for Ezhuvathiruthy and Ponnani Nagaram, indicating local survey activity.
Official survey process page describes survey and boundary work; not an open parcel data service.

Legacy official Kerala Bhu-Naksha viewer loaded under the parent-authorized, source-scoped TLS verification exception. Its public client code exposes parcel search and KL_PARCEL_BOUNDARY WMS, but no anonymous vector feature service was established; no parcel lookup was submitted.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.observation: Official viewer loaded with district/taluk/village selectors.
Selector metadata distinguishes all villages from published villages: Ponnani has 11 in the all-village list and zero published entries.
Page-backed request for Ponnani Nagaram returned a map-view shell identifying location_code 100308 and LAND_PARCEL layer; ephemeral authentication material was not retained.
Bounded 100 m EPSG:32643 export request around the WUP locator returned 0 bytes. This is an empty response, not a valid empty GeoJSON feature collection; no geometry was verified.
Loaded with a source-scoped certificate-verification exception explicitly authorized by the parent. Public viewer client code inspected; no parcel feature request sent.

research.blocker: Ente Bhoomi lists Ponnani Nagaram among all villages but not among villages with published maps; its bounded anonymous export returned an empty body. Legacy Bhu-Naksha exposes a WMS map layer but this pass did not retrieve vector features. Authenticated live parcel access was not attempted.
research.remainingUncertainty: Whether the WUP cluster overlaps Ponnani Taluk or Ponnani Nagaram; whether another anonymous feature endpoint exists behind the legacy viewer; parcel polygon geometry, stable parcel identity, full coverage and update vintage.
